120212.name: Camp Gan Israel Contra Costa
120212.note: First mention: J. The Jewish News of Northern California, Apr 23 1999 (camp advertisements; California Digital Newspaper Collection): 'Camp Gan Israel - Walnut Creek Chabad of Contra Costa 1530 ...'. J.'s 1998 camp ads list other Chabad camps (Camp Gan Israel of Chabad South Bay, Palo Alto) but not this one, and Chabad of Contra Costa itself began in Sept 1996. A first mention, so medium. Now in Danville.

earlier.where: Walnut Creek (as 'Camp Gan Israel - Walnut Creek', at Chabad of Contra Costa, 1530 ...)

831477.name: Camp Gan Israel SF
831477.note: First mention: J. The Jewish News of Northern California, May 11 2001 (camp advertisements; California Digital Newspaper Collection): 'Camp Gan Israel, SF Chabad SF 750 26th Ave. San Francisco'. Earlier J. camp ads (1998-1999) don't list it. A first mention, so medium; the chabad.org listing (about 2009) is much later.
